questions.question: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = total distance / total time = 120 km / 2 h = 60 km/h.

questions.question: A student walks 600 meters in 10 minutes. What is his walking speed in m/min?
questions.explanation: Speed = distance / time = 600 m / 10 min = 60 m/min.

questions.question: An object moves at a constant speed of 5 m/s for 4 seconds. How far does it travel?
questions.explanation: Distance = speed × time = 5 m/s × 4 s = 20 m.

questions.question: A box weighs 100 N and rests on a table with a contact area of 0.5 m². What is the pressure?
questions.explanation: Pressure = force / area = 100 N / 0.5 m² = 200 Pa.

questions.question: Which of the following can increase pressure?
questions.explanation: Pressure is inversely proportional to contact area when force is constant.

questions.question: The pressure at a certain depth in a liquid depends on which factors?
questions.explanation: Liquid pressure p = ρgh, depending on density and depth.

questions.question: According to Archimedes' principle, the buoyant force equals the weight of the ______.
questions.explanation: Archimedes' principle states that the buoyant force equals the weight of displaced fluid.

questions.question: A ship floats on water because the buoyant force is ______ its weight.
questions.explanation: Floating condition: buoyant force equals the object's weight.

questions.question: A resistor has 6 V across it and 2 A through it. What is its resistance?
questions.explanation: Ohm's law: R = U / I = 6 V / 2 A = 3 Ω.

questions.question: In a simple circuit, if voltage doubles and resistance stays the same, current ______.
questions.explanation: From I = U/R, current is directly proportional to voltage when R is constant.

questions.question: Which of the following describe uniform linear motion? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Uniform linear motion has constant speed and direction along a straight line.

questions.question: Ways to decrease pressure include: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Pressure = force/area; decreasing force or increasing area reduces pressure.

questions.question: Factors affecting buoyant force include: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: F_buoyant = ρ_fluid × g × V_displaced; it depends on fluid density and displaced volume.

questions.question: In a series circuit, which quantities are equal everywhere? (Select all that apply)
options: D. Charge passing per unit time
questions.explanation: In series circuits, current is the same everywhere; voltage and resistance may differ.

questions.question: The formula for average speed is v = ______.
questions.explanation: Average speed equals total distance divided by total time.

questions.question: Pressure is defined as force divided by ______.
questions.explanation: p = F/S, where S is the contact area.

questions.question: An object sinks when its density is ______ than the fluid's density.
questions.explanation: When object density exceeds fluid density, the object sinks.

questions.question: Ohm's law formula is I = ______.
questions.explanation: Current equals voltage divided by resistance.

questions.question: The unit of resistance is ______.
questions.explanation: Resistance is measured in ohms, symbol Ω.

questions.question: Average speed is always equal to the instantaneous speed at any moment.
questions.explanation: Average speed is total distance over total time; instantaneous speed can vary.

questions.question: Liquid pressure increases with depth.
questions.explanation: Liquid pressure p = ρgh increases linearly with depth h.

questions.question: An object immersed in fluid always experiences buoyant force downward.
questions.explanation: Buoyant force always acts vertically upward.

questions.question: A circuit has a 12 V battery and a 4 Ω resistor. Calculate the current flowing through the resistor.
questions.explanation: Using Ohm's law: I = U/R = 12 V / 4 Ω = 3 A.

questions.question: Two cars start from the same point. Car A moves at 60 km/h, Car B at 80 km/h in the same direction. What is the relative speed of B to A?
questions.explanation: Relative speed in same direction = 80 - 60 = 20 km/h.

questions.question: A train 200 m long passes through a 800 m tunnel at 25 m/s. How long does it take?
questions.explanation: Total distance = train length + tunnel length = 1000 m; time = 1000/25 = 40 s.

questions.question: A wooden block with base area 0.2 m² and mass 8 kg rests on a table. What is the pressure? (g = 10 N/kg)
questions.explanation: Force = mg = 80 N; pressure = 80 N / 0.2 m² = 400 Pa.

questions.question: Water pressure at 3 m depth in a pool is approximately ______. (ρ_water = 1000 kg/m³, g = 10 N/kg)
Which statement about liquid pressure is correct?
options: A. It depends on container shape
B. Equal in all directions at same depth
questions.explanation: At the same depth, liquid pressure is equal in all directions.

questions.question: A metal block with volume 0.002 m³ is fully submerged in water. What is the buoyant force? (ρ_water = 1000 kg/m³, g = 10 N/kg)
An object weighs 50 N in air and 30 N when fully submerged in water. What is the buoyant force?
questions.explanation: Buoyant force = weight in air - apparent weight in water = 50 - 30 = 20 N.

questions.question: Two resistors of 4 Ω and 6 Ω are connected in series to a 10 V battery. What is the circuit current?
questions.explanation: Total resistance = 4 + 6 = 10 Ω; I = U/R = 10/10 = 1 A.

questions.question: Two resistors of 6 Ω and 12 Ω are connected in parallel. What is the equivalent resistance?
In a parallel circuit with two branches, if one branch is broken, the other branch ______.
questions.explanation: In parallel circuits, branches work independently.

questions.question: Which statements about speed are correct? (Select all that apply)
options: A. Speed is a scalar quantity
C. Higher speed means more distance
questions.explanation: Speed is scalar with no direction; distance also depends on time.

questions.question: Ways to increase pressure on a surface include: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Adding wheels increases contact area and decreases pressure.

questions.question: An object floats in water but sinks in oil. This indicates: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Floating means less dense than fluid; sinking means denser than fluid.

questions.question: For a fixed resistor, which relationships are correct? (Select all that apply)
options: A. Current is proportional to voltage
B. I is inversely proportional to R
C. Resistance is proportional to voltage
D. R is inversely proportional to I
questions.explanation: For a fixed resistor, R is constant; I is proportional to U and inversely proportional to R.

questions.question: If an object travels 300 m in 15 s, its average speed is ______ m/s.
The pressure exerted by a liquid at a certain depth is calculated by p = ______.
questions.explanation: Liquid pressure formula: p = ρgh.

questions.question: According to Archimedes' principle, F_buoyant = ______.
questions.explanation: Buoyant force equals fluid density times g times displaced volume.

questions.question: In a series circuit, total resistance R_total = ______.
questions.explanation: Series resistances add directly.

questions.question: In a parallel circuit, total current I_total = ______.
questions.explanation: Kirchhoff's current law: total current equals the sum of branch currents.

questions.question: If two objects have the same speed, they must travel the same distance in the same time.
questions.explanation: Distance = speed × time; same speed and same time give same distance.

questions.question: At the same depth, water pressure is greater than alcohol pressure.
questions.explanation: Water has higher density than alcohol, so p = ρgh gives greater pressure at the same depth.

questions.question: In a parallel circuit, the voltage across each branch is the same.
questions.explanation: Parallel circuits have equal voltage across all branches.

questions.question: Explain why a sharp knife cuts better than a blunt knife using the concept of pressure.
questions.answer: A sharp knife has a smaller contact area. For the same force, smaller area produces greater pressure (p=F/S), making it easier to cut.
questions.explanation: Pressure is inversely proportional to contact area when force is constant.

questions.question: A ship with a weight of 5×10⁶ N floats on seawater. What is the buoyant force acting on it? Explain.
questions.answer: The buoyant force is 5×10⁶ N. Because the ship floats, the buoyant force equals its weight according to the floating condition.
questions.explanation: Floating objects have buoyant force equal to their weight.

questions.question: A car accelerates from rest to 20 m/s in 5 s, then moves at constant speed for 10 s. What is the average speed for the entire journey?
Two trains approach each other at 30 m/s and 20 m/s respectively. Initially 500 m apart, how long until they meet?
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 30 + 20 = 50 m/s; time = 500/50 = 10 s.

questions.question: A cube with side length 0.1 m and density 3000 kg/m³ sits on a table. What is the pressure on the table? (g = 10 N/kg)
questions.explanation: Mass = 3000 × 0.001 = 3 kg; force = 30 N; area = 0.01 m²; pressure = 30/0.01 = 3000 Pa.

questions.question: In a U-tube containing water and oil, the water column is 8 cm and the oil column is 10 cm. What is the density of the oil?
questions.explanation: At equilibrium, ρ_oil × g × 0.1 = ρ_water × g × 0.08; ρ_oil = 800 kg/m³.

questions.question: A hollow metal ball weighs 8 N in air and 5 N in water. Its volume is 0.0004 m³. What is the average density of the ball?
An ice cube floats in water with 1/10 of its volume above the surface. What is the density of ice?
questions.explanation: 9/10 submerged means ρ_ice/ρ_water = 9/10; ρ_ice = 900 kg/m³.

questions.question: A circuit contains a 12 V source, a 4 Ω resistor, and a 6 Ω resistor in series. What is the voltage across the 4 Ω resistor?
questions.explanation: Current = 12/10 = 1.2 A; voltage across 4 Ω = 1.2 × 4 = 4.8 V.

questions.question: Three identical resistors R are connected: two in parallel, then in series with the third. What is the total resistance?
questions.explanation: Two in parallel give R/2; in series with R gives 1.5R.

questions.question: A 60 W lamp designed for 220 V is connected to 110 V. Assuming resistance is constant, what is its actual power?
questions.explanation: P = U²/R; at half voltage, power is 1/4 of rated power: 60/4 = 15 W.

questions.question: In a circuit with a sliding rheostat, if the resistance increases, the current in the circuit ______.
questions.explanation: From Ohm's law I = U/R, increasing resistance decreases current when voltage is constant.

questions.question: Which statements about uniform motion are correct? (Select all that apply)
options: A. Equal distances in equal times
questions.explanation: Uniform motion has constant velocity, meaning constant speed, direction, and zero acceleration.

questions.question: Which factors affect liquid pressure at a point? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Liquid pressure p = ρgh depends on density, depth, and gravity, not container shape.

questions.question: Which conditions will make a submerged object rise? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Rising occurs when buoyant force exceeds weight, which happens when object density is less than fluid density or fluid density increases.

questions.question: Which statements about electrical power are correct? (Select all that apply)
options: D. Power is independent of voltage
questions.explanation: Power can be calculated using P=UI, P=I²R, or P=U²/R; it depends on both voltage and current.

questions.question: For an object starting from rest with uniform acceleration a, the distance traveled in time t is s = ______.
questions.explanation: Using s = vt + ½at² with initial velocity v=0.

questions.question: Atmospheric pressure at sea level is approximately ______ Pa.
questions.explanation: Standard atmospheric pressure is about 1.01×10⁵ Pa.

questions.question: The buoyant force on a fully submerged object can be calculated as F = ρ_fluid × g × ______.
questions.explanation: For fully submerged objects, displaced volume equals object volume.

questions.question: In a series circuit, the voltage ratio across two resistors equals their ______ ratio.
questions.explanation: U1/U2 = R1/R2 in series circuits because current is the same.

questions.question: Electrical energy consumed by a resistor can be calculated as W = ______.
questions.explanation: Electrical work W = UIt, also expressible as U²t/R or I²Rt.

questions.question: In uniform accelerated motion starting from rest, the displacement is directly proportional to the square of time.
questions.explanation: s = ½at² shows displacement is proportional to t².

questions.question: A ship sailing from river to sea will rise slightly because seawater is denser than river water.
questions.explanation: In denser fluid, less volume needs to be displaced to achieve the same buoyant force equal to the ship's weight.

questions.question: The resistance of a conductor is directly proportional to the voltage across it.
questions.explanation: Resistance is an intrinsic property; it does not depend on voltage or current for ohmic materials.

questions.question: A household circuit has a 220 V supply. A kettle rated at 1100 W is connected. Calculate the current drawn and the resistance of the kettle.
questions.answer: Current I = P/U = 1100/220 = 5 A. Resistance R = U/I = 220/5 = 44 Ω.
questions.explanation: Using P = UI and Ohm's law R = U/I.
